items.difficulty_reason: The fibre product site (V x_y X)' is identified with the localization of X_lisse-etale at the sheaf of sets (f')^{-1}h_y (cited localization lemma), so pr' is a localization morphism whose inverse image preserves injectives; an injective resolution then computes R^p f'_* pointwise as the cohomology of the Gamma complex of the pulled-back resolution, which is an injective resolution of the pullback.
